hero.description: Alvor Healthcare has grown from a regional pharmaceutical manufacturer to a globally recognized healthcare company committed to quality, innovation, and patient care.

mission.title: Mission, Vision & Values
mission.description: Our founding principles guide every decision and action.
mission.valuesSummary: Patient safety, quality excellence, innovation, integrity, sustainability, and global accessibility guide every decision we make.

coreValues.title: Patient Safety First
coreValues.description: Every product undergoes rigorous testing to support safety, quality, and efficacy.

coreValues.title: Quality Excellence
coreValues.description: Quality systems and certified facilities support consistent manufacturing standards.

coreValues.title: Continuous Innovation
coreValues.description: Research and development programs improve formulations and delivery methods.

coreValues.title: Patient-Centric Care
coreValues.description: Accessible medicines and support programs remain central to our work.

coreValues.title: Global Accessibility
coreValues.description: Reliable distribution partnerships help medicines reach international markets.

coreValues.title: Sustainable Practices
coreValues.description: Responsible manufacturing initiatives reduce waste and environmental impact.
